[[Your Child (DS)|Possible child]] |rival = [[Nami (DS)|Nami]] |wife lunches = |unlock by = |appearances = [[Gustafa (AWL)|AWL, AWLSE, AnWL]], '''DS, Cute''', [[Gustafa (SoSAWL)|SoSAWL]] }} {{Youmay|Gustafa, a character from [[Harvest Moon DS]]|[[Gustafa]] as he appears in other games throughout the series.}} {{Nihongo|Gustafa|グスタ|Gusta}} is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]] ''and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]. ''He is one of the eligible bachelors available to court in ''Cute''. '''Gustafa''' is a free spirited person who has a laid back and very positive outlook on life. He has a love for nature and for art. He is a sensitive individual who is somewhat alone. He lives near [[Daryl (DS)|Daryl]]'s in his own yurt on the corner of town. Gustafa is a musician who enjoys spending time in the valley, looking for places that give him inspiration to write music. He spends most of his time at the turtle pond or at the windmills on Vesta's farm during the day, and enjoys spending evenings at the Blue Bar. If the player wishes to pursue a relationship with Gustafa, [[Nami (DS)|Nami]] will become the rival for his affection. The two free spirited travelers have a lot in common, and if they marry, Nami will live with Gustafa in his yurt.  ==Schedule== {| class="storyschedule_table" |- ! colspan="2" |Wednesday to Monday (All Weather) |- |6am - 8am |Inside Home |- |8am - 8:30am |Walking to Turtle Pond |- |8:30am - 5pm |Standing in front of Turtle Pond |- |5pm - 5:40pm |Walking to Blue Bar |- |5:40pm - 10pm |Blue Bar |- |10pm - 11:20pm |Walking Home |- |11:20am - 6am |Inside Home |- ! colspan="2" |Tuesdays (All Weather) |- |6am - 8am |Inside Home |- |8am - 9:30am |Walking to Vesta's |- |9:30am - 5pm |Under Windmills at Vesta's |- |5pm - 6:30pm |Walking Home |- |6:30pm - 6am |Inside Home |} ==Gifts[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/gustafa.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com== {{Infobox Gift |special = Hot Milk |loved = Popcorn, Omelet Rice, French Toast, Boiled Egg, Rainbow Curry, Ultimate Curry, Finest Curry, Pizza, Pickled Turnips, Pickled Cucumbers |liked = Curry Dishes (All), Flowers (All), Ores (All), Gems (All), Jewelery (All), Sunblock, Facial Pack, Skin Lotion, Milk, Peach, Rice Cake, Stir Fry, Fried Rice, Savory Pancake, Omelet, Tempura, Pot Stickers, Dry Curry, Strawberry Jam, Noodles, Relaxtea, Roasted Rice Cake, Baked Yam, Sweet Potatoes, Cheesecake, Strawberry Milk, Fruit Latte, Mixed Latte, Chinese Bun, Steamed Dumplings, Sandwich, Relaxtea Leaves |neutral = ''Items not listed.'' |disliked = Shiitake, Matsutake, Bamboo Shoots, Tomato, Colored Grass (All) Perfume, Wood Lumber, Stone Lumber, Dog Ball, Bodigizer, Turbojolt, Vegetable Juice, Bodigizer XL, Turbojolt XL |hated = Toadstool, Fish, Pirate Treasure, Fish Fossil, Lithograph, Junk, Gold Lumber, Fodder, Bird Feed, Grilled Fish, Fish Stew, Sushi |horror = Sashimi }} ==Heart Events== '''Black Heart Event'''[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/gustafa.php DS Cute Bachelors] fogu.com Location: Walk from Beach to Turtle Pond
Schedule: 9am to 5pm, not Tuesday (Sunny) As you leave the beach area, you'll hear your name being called from near the Turtle Pond. It's Gustafa calling, and he asks if you'd like to chat with him. Tell him that you would like to, and he'll ask if you have pride in your work. If you agree, Gustafa will start to sing happily, but quickly apologizes and wishes you luck. {{Clr}} ---- '''Purple Heart Event'''[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/gustafa.php DS Cute Bachelors] fogu.com When you leave your house between 6and 8on a sunny day, Gustafa will be at the front door. He asks if you'd like to come bird watching with him today. Tell him that you would like to go to advance the event, the duo will go to the beach. Gustafa says that it's easy to make music at the beach, because of the scenery and nature around him. He asks if you too sometimes see beautiful images that you just cannot put into words. If you answer with "Sometimes", he will be happy that you feel the same way. He thanks you for the time spent together, and walks you home. {{Clr}} ---- '''Blue Heart Event'''[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/gustafa.php DS Cute Bachelors] fogu.com Location: Walk from Main Pathway to Your Farm
Schedule: 7pm to 10pm, not Tuesday, Sunny day As you walk to your farm, Gustafa will call from behind you. He decided to stop by your house to invite you for a walk this evening. Reply to his invite with, "Sure, let's go!" to continue the event.  The duo will walk around town, but still stop to take a break at the Turtle Pond. Gustafa decides that a night walk is good every once in a while, because the scenery is all so different. Gustafa thinks that Forget-Me-Not Valley is a great place, but suddenly remembers that he has been rambling on! He apologizes and walks you back to your home for the evening.  {{Clr}} ---- '''Yellow Heart Event'''[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/gustafa.php DS Cute Bachelors] fogu.com Location: Gustafa's House
Schedule: 6am to 8am Gustafa will greet you at his house, and explain that he's just finished making a new song. He's stumped on what to write next, so he decides to write about you! Gustafa asks if you'd tell him about your life on the farm so he can gather inspiration. Answer with "Sure, I'll tell you" to give Gustafa some ideas.  The player will do a small demonstration, and Gustafa will thank you afterwards. Gustafa thinks it would be fun to live on the farm together, and thanks you for your time.  ==Rival Heart Events== '''Black Heart''' Leave the beach between 3pm and 6pm on a sunny day. It cannot be Tuesday or Thursday.[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/gustafa.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Gustafa and Nami are talking about the freedoms of traveling. Gustafa feels that people who travel are open-minded and kind. Nami tells Gustafa that she gets that feeling from him. Gustafa thanks her. {{Clr}} ---- '''Blue Heart''' Enter the beach area between 12pm and 3pm on a sunny day. It cannot be a Tuesday or Thursday and it must be Year 2 or later. Additionally, the first rival event have been previously seen.[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/gustafa.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Gustafa and Nami are walking on the beach when Gustafa comments on how pretty the ocean is. Nami appreciates it too, since she didn't get to see much of it when she was traveling. Gustafa explains to Nami that he stays in the valley for the wonderful scenery and the people. When he asks why Nami stays, she doesn't have an answer for him, so Gustafa leaves her to her thoughts.{{Clr}} ---- '''Green Heart''' Enter the beach area between 12pm and 3pm on a sunny day. It cannot be a Tuesday or Thursday and it must be Year 3 or later. Additionally, all previous rival events must have been already been seen.[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/gustafa.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Nami is looking out onto the ocean and thinking about her life. Gustafa sees her, and asks what she's thinking about. Nami asks Gustafa if it's okay for her to be content with how things are going right now. Gustafa tells Nami not to think too hard about it, and the answers will come naturally to her with some time. Nami thanks him. {{Clr}} ---- '''Orange Heart''' Walk from the pond to the beach between 12pm and 3pm on a sunny day. It cannot be a Tuesday or Thursday and it must also be Year 4 or later. All previous rival events must have already been seen.[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/gustafa.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Gustafa and Nami are talking by the pond. Gustafa asks Nami if she plans on travelling more, but Nami doesn't think she needs to travel. She thinks that the valley suits her best, and she wants to say. Gustafa agrees that he also loves the valley, and tells Nami that his place is by her side. ==References== {{Reflist|3}} {{HMDSCharacters}} [[Category:Harvest Moon DS]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute Bachelors]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Rivals]]
